IT Consulting

Joe Klemke is a solution architect and technical project manager. He consults through Vernacular Cloud LLC, a small company based in Colorado.

Services

  • Solution architecture: requirements, system integration and technical design, from proof of concept to delivery.
  • Technical sales support: explaining and demonstrating technical products, and helping customers adopt them.
  • Project management: PRINCE2 and Scrum practice, scaled to the size of the work.
  • AI-assisted delivery: running projects with an AI assistant using graszp, a one-note solution architecture method.

Background

About twenty years with Logica, later CGI, in the UK, as solution and technical architect, technical project manager and senior developer. Clients were in healthcare, automotive, oil and gas, the public sector, finance and telecoms. Before that, software development at MapInfo and web application team leadership at Partners Healthcare. Methods: TOGAF, ArchiMate, PRINCE2, Scrum and ITIL.

Since 2021 Joe has also run small businesses (finance, payroll, contracts, compliance and trademark registration) and built semantic-web publishing pipelines in Python and JavaScript on AWS and GitHub.
